content: The Saber Sneakers are priced at $86 and come in a variety of colors including Serene, Tiffany, Dirty Blue, Sand, Light Green, Light Blue, Olive, Light Brown, Lilac, Khaki, Turquoise, Orange, Black, and Dark Blue. They are available in sizes 41 to 48. You can view an image of the sneakers here: [Saber Sneakers Image](https://7saber.uz/storage/product/45947vtkXtKLKh6zxQX1e.jpg).
